construct: NO CONSTRUCT -- ex vivo human material. TWO CAVEATS, BOTH LOAD-BEARING. (1) THE FILAMENT IS HETEROMERIC: this is not an ANXA11 homo-amyloid but a co-assembly with TDP-43, the two chains forming one fold with an extensive hydrophobic interface. The region is therefore the ordered core OF ANXA11 WITHIN A HETEROMERIC FILAMENT, and it is not evidence that 39-74 would nucleate alone. See _COAGGREGATION_IS_THREE_DIFFERENT_PHENOMENA. (2) THE PROTEIN IS TRUNCATED: most ANXA11 in the filaments is an approximately 22 kDa fragment lacking the annexin core domain, detected by antibodies to residues 3-15 and 1-180 but NOT to 276-505, i.e. C-TERMINALLY truncated; a minor full-length 56 kDa form is also present. The authors do not establish whether truncation precedes or follows filament formation. So scoring the 505-residue chain scores a molecule that is mostly not the aggregating species -- the same problem as the TMEM106B row.

construct: NO CONSTRUCT, AND NOT RECOMBINANT -- WHICH CUTS BOTH WAYS. Native protein: defatted soybean flour -> soybean protein isolate -> glycinin fraction (pH 4.8 precipitation) -> dissociated into acidic (glycinin-A) and basic (glycinin-B) subunits by 90 C / 30 min in 30 mM Tris-HCl, 15 mM beta-mercaptoethanol, pH 8.0, then pH precipitation, dialysis (MWCO 3.5 kDa), lyophilisation. Fibrillisation: "Protein solutions (20 mg mL-1, pH 2.0) were heated at 90 C for 12 h under constant magnetic stirring (500 rpm)". || THREE CONSTRUCT CAVEATS, ALL MATERIAL. (1) THE STARTING MATERIAL IS A MIXTURE, NOT A PROTEIN. "glycinin-A" is the pooled acidic subunits of at least five glycinin gene products (G1-G5); the paper reports ">90% purity" of the FRACTION, which is a statement about the absence of other soy proteins, not about which glycinin gene is in it. (2) THE FIBRIL-FORMING SPECIES WAS NEVER WEIGHED OR SEQUENCED. SDS-PAGE was run on the starting fractions (Figure 1a) and NOT on the fibrils; there is no mass spectrometry anywhere in the paper -- grep of the full text returns 0 hits for "mass spec" and 0 for "hydroly". So whether the fibrils contain intact acidic subunit or chain fragments is not addressed. 12 h at pH 2.0 and 90 C is a condition under which acid hydrolysis of the backbone would be expected, and for other food proteins fibrillation under exactly this protocol is reported to proceed via hydrolysis-generated peptides -- BUT THAT IS BACKGROUND, NOT A SOURCE OPENED HERE, and is recorded as an open question, not as a finding. (3) pH 2.0 AND 90 C IS A DENATURING CONDITION the paper itself labels as such ("fibrils formed under denaturing conditions (90 C, pH 2.0)"). Nothing here speaks to aggregation at physiological pH.
found_by: CRYO-EM DENSITY plus SEQUENCE-TO-DENSITY MATCHING. NO AGGREGATION PREDICTOR IS IN THE DISCOVERY PATH -- checked against Methods and Results, not the abstract. The path, in the paper's own order: (a) de novo model building with ModelAngelo 1.0 "without sequence constraints", yielding the consensus string "NNIIAMSLDISNFNNELTMTVRVFYLI" "derived by assigning the highest-frequency amino acid at each residue position along the parallel beta-sheet layers"; (b) alignment of that model against the five glycinin-A sequences, giving "optimal matches with two segments: Pro164-Ala190 of glycinin G4 and G5"; (c) corroboration by "ModelAngelo's hmm_search algorithm, which independently identified glycinin G4 and G5 as the top-ranking candidates"; (d) a density-fit call between G4 and G5. NOTE A NUANCE IN (a): the Methods say the models actually refined were built "using ModelAngelo 1.0 with five candidate sequences of glycinin-A", so the sequence-free pass produced the consensus while the deposited models were built from a candidate set restricted a priori to glycinin. That restriction comes from knowing what was in the tube, not from a predictor. || THE ONLY PREDICTORS IN THE PAPER ARE STRUCTURE PREDICTORS, USED POST HOC: AlphaFold supplies the "folded glycinin G4" monomer in Figure 4a, and AlphaFold3 appears in the Discussion to contrast single-chain predictions with the observed fibril. Neither predicts aggregation, and both were run on a region the structure had already fixed.
